description: Canonical seed registry for runtime policies. Phase 1 documents current behavior and does not introduce a new policy engine.

policies.current_behavior: workspace_file_router writes require twin approval before writing content to disk.
network_data_fetch is blocked when the default diagnostic profile is active.
Repo-relative paths are resolved through workspace_mounter and rejected if they escape the repository root.
The platform worker limits a task to 5 model/tool loops before failing and archiving the payload.
The runtime uses local queues, local filesystem state, and an Ollama-compatible local model endpoint by default.
Unknown, missing, disabled, or incomplete repository profiles fall back to RuntimeDiagnosticAgent and RuntimeDiagnosticTwinAgent.
